paragraphs: I'm applying for the FP&A Associate role at Fervo. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Fervo interests me because the job sits where project budgets, capex forecasting and capital allocation meet, for a company building 24/7 clean power when demand from data centers keeps growing.

At Lenovo I built forecasts, models and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region. In my MBA I built project and portfolio models for a 35.4 MW solar portfolio covering capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR.

That maps to the work in the posting: project and corporate budgets, capex tracking, variance explanations and executive review materials. I haven't worked in transaction advisory or audit, so my path into this is planning and analytics rather than accounting, but I'd bring careful models and clear explanations for non-finance teams. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
